text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Which race will Hokko Tarumae be
taking on
after the February Stakes?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We learn the answer to that question
during a TV
interview.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Really? You plan on running overseas?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes, in the Middle East. I plan on
competing in an
international G1 race in
Dubai!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Will you be running as a
representative of
the Umamusume of
Japan?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Not quite... I'm the tourism ambassador
for
Tomakomai, right? I'll show the world
it's
Tomako-time!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Oh... Did I mess up that joke?!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Uh...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I had no idea Tarumae was
planning on
going to Dubai!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The international dirt G1 in Dubai is one
of the
most prestigious races in the
entire world.
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was a bold move...
Yeah, that was quite the bold move...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's incredibly difficult to put on a good

performance there. But Hokko Tarumae
has
decided to go anyway...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The following day...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. I want to talk to Tarumae.
Is that
okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For whatever reason, Copano Rickey
looks very
serious as we head over to
see Hokko Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Rickey. Did the news surprise
you? I've
actually been thinking about it
for some time
now.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering what I needed to do to
put
Tomakomai on the map, and I
figured the only
way was to make waves
on the world stage.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Imagine—if I win, everyone will know

Tomakomai's name.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: So you're doing this for Tomakomai...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That's not the only reason, though.
You're
actually another reason, Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Wait, I am?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. The February Stakes made me
realize that
if I don't do something now,
I probably won't be
able to keep
winning against you.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
So I have to compete in an even bigger
race and
become even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I can't let myself lose to you, Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey falls silent. As a trainer,
I'm
curious about a few aspects of
Hokko Tarumae's
plan.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: A backup... plan? ...Competition?
choice_data_list: Are the backup system and matchmaking all set?
Are the backup system and matchmaking okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Racing overseas isn't something you can
succeed
at with willpower alone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Careful planning is required, and it's
important to
determine whether a runner
is suited to travel in
the first place.
When I ask her about these
things...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I have some backup ideas, but I'm not
sure how
well I'll hold up against the
other racers.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I had a pretty comfortable upbringing in
the
countryside, so I'm not great when it
comes to
unfamiliar places.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Tarumae! In that case...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
But I'll be fine! My love for my
hometown can
overcome any hurdle!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Besides... this is partially about getting
revenge
for what happened to Falco.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Once before, she competed in the same
race I'll
be running in. But when she
did...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
She got completely surrounded at the
very start,
and couldn't break away like
she normally does.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
When I saw on TV how sad she was that
she
couldn't showcase her full strength...
I just
couldn't stop crying...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I really look up to her as an Umadol, and
now
that I'm stronger, I want to run my
best to make
up for all her frustration!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I think I can handle it! No... I know I can!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Just watch, Rickey! This spring, I'm
gonna work
even harder'n you, and put a
great big gap
between us!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Shhhooommm!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Hokko Tarumae leaves for
Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's almost time for the big race, and we
have no
real idea how things are going in
Dubai...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae hasn't been updating her
Umastagram at
all lately...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I hope that's all it is... but I can't shake
the feeling
there's more to it. I mean...
choice_data_list: I wonder if they're busy getting ready for the race.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: She's Tomakomai's tourism ambassador.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No matter what happens, she never
forgets to
promote her hometown...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...She makes a good point. Hokko
Tarumae would
never waste such a great
advertising opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I have a bad feeling about this...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should have told her. I know she
wouldn't
have believed me, but...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Her trip was in the Five Ghosts direction.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's the second most dangerous
and unlucky
direction, second only to
the one signifying total
loss.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The night I learned that Tarumae was
going
overseas...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae won't believe me, no matter
what I say.
But...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No. I'll hold off for now. If things start to
look
better, then I can tell her. Yeah! It's
probably
wiser to wait and see how
things pan out!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But maybe things would be better now if
I'd told
her what I knew... Unless...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Was keeping it to myself the right thing
to do?
Maybe we'll all be able to laugh
about this after
the race is over, right,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what to say. Until now,
Rickey's feng
shui readings have almost
always been accurate...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And then, on the day of the race...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: In sixteenth place, Hokko Tarumae!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Last place?! What happened? Truly a
lackluster
performance!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
There have also been reports that the
water there
doesn't quite agree with her.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Tarumae... Tarumae!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae suffers a major defeat
and
returns to Japan in shambles. And
that's not all...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She goes on to announce that she'll be
taking a
break from racing. Copano
Rickey's most
important rival is now out
of the picture.
